title: FUSION: Full-Body Unified Motion Prior for Body and Hands via Diffusion
summary: Unifies body and hand datasets into a full-body motion prior, with optimization-driven object-motion and self-interaction applications.
limitations: Random hand/body combinations lack sequence-level semantic correlation. Stable-grasp assumption limits contact changes; controlled prior applications do not establish text+initial-state HOI generation.
method: Unconditional SMPL-X diffusion prior jointly models body/hands; task losses backpropagate through denoising to optimize noise. Local hand transfer preserves body wrists and filters additional penetration.
conditions: Keypoint tracking supplies future joint constraints. HOI uses object motion and a GRABNet grasp assumed stable during motion. Self-interaction uses LLM-derived contacts/timesteps; object motion is not generated.
evaluation: HumanML3D tracking errors; MotionCritic body realism; fingertip/hand perception and self-interaction ablations. Standard text-motion FID/R-precision are not reported for its representation.
dataset_genealogy: Body sources: AMASS/ARCTIC/OMOMO/SAMP/BEAT2; hands: ARCTIC/TCDHands/GRAB/HOT3D/MOYO/InterHand2.6M/Re:InterHand. Native correlated hands retained when available; mirror/reversal augmentations are derivatives.

title: Template Free Reconstruction of Human-object Interaction with Procedural Interaction Generation
summary: Procedurally creates varied human-object interaction pairs and trains an image-conditioned reconstruction model for unseen objects.
limitations: Static pairs/images, not motion sequences or motion hours. Seed poses limit diversity; occluded-body shape recovery remains difficult. HDM does not handle multi-person/multi-object interactions.
method: Category-specific autoencoder correspondences transfer contacts to replacement objects; joint pose optimization preserves contact and reduces collisions, followed by textured rendering. HDM reconstructs joint then separate human/object point clouds.
conditions: Data synthesis requires captured seed interaction poses and same-category replacement geometry. HDM takes one RGB image without an object template; output is static shape/interaction reconstruction.
evaluation: BEHAVE/InterCap reconstruction F-score at 1 cm, data/model ablations, cross-dataset and unseen-shape/category evaluation.
dataset_genealogy: Seeds sampled from BEHAVE/InterCap training interactions; ShapeNet/ABO/Objaverse supply replacement objects and MGN supplies clothed humans. Approximately 1.1M rendered images are derivative data, not new captures.

title: InterMask: 3D Human Interaction Generation via Collaborative Masked Modelling
summary: Collaboratively predicts masked discrete motion tokens for two people and also supports reaction generation.
limitations: Mesh conversion can reveal inter-person penetration; rapid actions can jerk; dataset dance bias remains. Two-person generation does not establish arbitrary population or persistent object-state reasoning.
method: Shared 2D VQ-VAE preserves spatial/temporal tokens; collaborative transformer combines self, spatiotemporal and cross-person attention. Iterative confidence remasking generates both actors jointly.
conditions: Main task: text with both actors initially masked. Reaction: full reference actor motion stays unmasked, with optional text; this is future actor-conditioned completion, not a demonstrated causal online policy.
evaluation: InterHuman/InterX FID, R-precision, MMDist, diversity/multimodality; attention/masking/tokenizer ablations, reaction tests and user study.
dataset_genealogy: Trains/evaluates existing InterHuman and InterX interaction recordings, with separate representations; shared individual tokenization does not create new independent capture data.

title: ParaHome: Parameterizing Everyday Home Activities Towards 3D Generative Modeling of Human-Object Interactions
summary: Captures full-body, hand, multi-object and articulated-object activity in a home setting, including sequential and concurrent manipulations.
limitations: Single home setup, artificial markers and restricted object collection limit generalization. Text-model interpolation is not proof of robust unseen skill composition. Paper reports inconsistent 207/208 capture totals; retain source distinction.
method: New capture system aligns multicamera object tracking with IMU body/glove motion and post-processing. Baselines study text-conditioned body/hand synthesis and transformer object-state-conditioned body synthesis.
conditions: Text baseline generates human motion. Object-guided baseline supplies object motion over the full target window plus spatial relations/initial state; it does not predict object motion from text+initial state.
evaluation: Capture/calibration and post-processing checks; ParaHome-only/HumanML3D-only/mixed text-motion metrics; object-guided positional errors and foot skating; latent interpolation demonstrations.
dataset_genealogy: Original ParaHome continuous captures: 38 participants, 486 minutes; text baseline additionally downsamples/mixes HumanML3D. Mixed training does not make HumanML3D newly captured hand-object data.
